one_liner: Amazon SP-API is a broad REST API for seller/vendor data using LWA OAuth 2.0; builders need a Professional seller account ($39.99/mo) and Amazon-reviewed developer profile and role approvals.
auth_notes: Login with Amazon OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow yields refresh tokens exchanged for 1-hour access tokens; private apps can self-authorize in draft status. Restricted operations use Restricted Data Tokens. Public apps must be listed in the Appstore.
access_notes: Requires a Professional selling account (paid, $39.99/month), a Developer Profile that Amazon reviews, and role approvals; restricted roles need extra review. Public apps have further requirements.
blocker_notes: Developer profile review by Amazon and role approval, plus a paid Professional seller account, are required before meaningful use. Public multi-user apps need Appstore listing.
